topography.project_purpose: Flying Tulip is a multi-chain DeFi protocol offering yield aggregation, lending, and a stablecoin (ftUSD) backed by options strategies. It enables users to deposit assets into yield-optimizing vaults, borrow against them, and mint ftUSD through put option mechanisms.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol shares infrastructure across families: ftYieldWrapper contracts are used in both Lend and ftPUT to wrap yield-bearing tokens, while oracle and circuit breaker systems are shared between ftUSD and ftPUT. Governance contracts like SessionManager and ACL control access across multiple product lines.
